title: UnitIndexService
responsibility: Reconciles indexed source with registered ownership, contracts and lineage, retaining existing IDs and reporting additions, moves, revivals and orphaned units.

inputs.name: UnitIndexService.index.index
inputs.description: Source facts and conventional identities for one revision; the source map is not reordered.

inputs.name: UnitIndexService.index.existing
inputs.description: Existing active and retired registry records whose stable identities and authored declarations must survive reconciliation.

inputs.name: modelCompanions.index
inputs.description: Indexed storage declarations used to identify persisted-model companions.

inputs.name: modelCompanions.existing
inputs.description: Prior registry records; matching persisted companions retain retired identities and predecessor lineage.

outputs.name: UnitIndexService.index
outputs.description: Reconciled manifests plus explicit added, updated, moved, revived and orphaned ID lists; does not write the registry.

outputs.name: modelCompanions
outputs.description: Registry projection that folds persisted-model companion ownership and redirects dependencies while retaining tombstones.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: Schema validation, caller-provided getters, iterators or serialization can throw; this value operation does not perform filesystem I/O.
